result.title: A Backdoor Trigger Is Legible in Fine-Tune Weights
result.summary: A backdoored language model behaves normally until a trigger phrase appears in its input. Every published method for recovering such a trigger runs the model. We show the trigger is legible in the weights alone: a static statistic reads a fine-tuned checkpoint with no forward pass of the suspect, no data, no labelled population of poisoned models and no prior knowledge that a backdoor exists, and names one of the tokens of the trigger phrase as the single highest-ranked candidate in the vocabulary.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出一种纯静态的权重统计方法，在不对模型做前向、不接触数据、也没有毒化模型样本和先验的情况下，直接从微调检查点中读出后门触发短语，并将其中一个 token 排为词表最高候选。
AI.relevance_reason: 「不运行模型即从权重读出特定行为依赖」的概念，或可启发性地用于核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真正写入参数/状态、以及推理是否依赖虚假线索这类捷径，但与视觉多模态推理主线距离较远，需较多核查。
